name: CryptoRisk API
description: Wallet & token risk scoring for EVM chains (Ethereum, Base). Returns a 0-100 risk score, verdict (PROCEED/CAUTION/BLOCK), and flags including OFAC sanctions matches, known scam/phishing addresses, and token honeypot/rug signals. Free data sources, sub-cent pricing.

resources.description: Full wallet/token risk report: risk_score, risk_level, verdict, flags, reasons, signals, sources.
FREE demo: risk_score, risk_level, verdict, and flags (no detailed reasons/sources).
